FIRST AMENDMENT 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited (referred to as “Developer” ) and Mr. [ ● ] (individually, or in the case of joint buyers and collectively referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first amendment (“ First Amendment ”) to Agreement to Sell No. [ ● ] dated [ ● ] , (“ Agreement ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [ ● ] (“ Effective Date ”). 
 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement for the purchase of the apartment more fully described in the Description of the Unit of a residential housing project by the Developer, named and styled as ‘Zameen Quadrangle , consisting of residential apartments and shops located at Plot No. 49 , Zafar Ali Road , Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Deve loper had notified the Buyer through a Letter of Intimation of Zameen Quadrangle dated [ ● ] about the continued surge in prices of Component Materials which has prompted an adjustment in the Purchase Price to the extent of the Adjusted Amount under Clause 3.3 and the Buyer has acknowledged such adjustment; and 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 15 .2 of the Agreement, Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement to incorporate the revised payment plan as per the provisions of this First Amendment. 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as f o l l ows: 
 The First Amendment shall be effective from the Effective Date. 
 The Payment Plan specified in Attachment A of the Agreement is hereby revised and replaced with the Payment Plan specified in Attachment B /1 appended to this First Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, the Payment Plan in Attachment A shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. All references to Attachment A in the Agreement shall be deemed to be references to Attachment B /1 appended to this First Amendment. 
 The Parties agree that adjustment in the Purchase Price to the extent of the Adjusted Amount under Clause 3.3 is final and no further changes shall be made to the Purchase Price under Clause 3.3. 
 This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in the First Amendment unless otherwise specified herein. 
 The First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute the same amendment. 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses. 
 
 SIGNED: 
 
 
 For and on behalf of BUYER 
 
 
 
 For and on behalf of JOINT BUYER 
 
 
 For and on behalf of DEVELOPER
